GREEN BUILDING AND OPERATIONS 
CERTIFICATIONS
Until recently, we have pursued green building 
certifications on a case-by-case basis. In 2023, we 
committed to achieving BREEAM certification at all new 
European facilities and LEED at all new North American 
facilities. For all new facilities we design and construct in 
Europe, we are targeting BREEAM Very Good certification. 
This process is in progress for the following facilities:
• London (LON5)
• Frankfurt (FRA4-6)
• Madrid (MAD1)
Our new facility in Madrid is acting as a pilot development 
for BREEAM Spain and will become the first data center in 
Spain built under the BREEAM Data Centres International 
accreditation. 
For all new facilities we design and construct in North 
America, we are targeting LEED certification. This process 
is in progress for the following facilities:
• Dallas (DFW4)
• Raleigh-Durham (DUR2)
• Chicago (CHI6)
• Pacific Northwest (PNW1)
• Columbus (COL1)
• Phoenix (PHX20) 
• San Antonio (SAT8)
• San Antonio (SAT9)
The table to the right shows green building certifications 
that cover some or all of each building as of the end of 
2023.
